name: Hideous Laughter
description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range perceives everything as hilariously funny and falls into fits of laughter. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or fall prone with laughter, becoming incapacitated. At the end of each of its turns it can make another Wisdom save, ending the effect on a success.
effect: On a failed Wisdom save the target is helpless with laughter (can't act; attacks against it have advantage) until it shakes it off.
notes: In combat: a failed Wisdom save leaves the target helpless with laughter: it can't act, and attacks against it have advantage. It saves again at the end of each of its turns. Concentration, 10 rounds.
